objective: simulated owner net per season (V2 market, all-in guest price)
harm_basis: Margin = 50% of the smallest gain worth deploying (FDA non-inferiority M2 = 0.5 x M1 convention). Smallest worthwhile gain taken as 4% of current-practice owner net (~$14.6k/season on the v2 screen), which exceeds plausible running costs; 50% of it is 2%. Per-home segment margin 3%: one home has a third of the data, so its estimate is noisier. Fixed before any V3 board exists.

screen.note: Fresh seeds: every earlier board ran seeds 1-30 only (exposed_seeds, 2026-10-16). scrape_degraded is screened too: the v2 simulator scrapes kindly in normal (8% missing), where the anchor repair barely acts (audit S6).

stop_conditions: any change to candidate policy, calibration or code_paths after freeze (new candidate)
any board made by other code, from a dirty tree, or started before the freeze
any held-out seed opened before the screen gate passes
